ad_info.structure_source: library format F65 (plan) translated onto the winning structure estructuras/mv-35.json (Reencuadre del problema con 3 siluetas y bloque de oferta)
ad_info.reference_style: Clean reframe ad: big 3-line headline in fuchsia and black that says what the problem is NOT and what it IS, three line-art profile silhouettes of the same woman over time, an offer block with three bottles
ad_info.angle_used: Dolor / problema — squats alone are not the whole plan (pain: months of squats and the seat looks the same)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: rosy cream #FFF4F1 background and a soft yellow #FFE08A highlight behind the word 'NO'.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean flat line illustration on a light background, like the reference, with the three real bottles photographic and sharp.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: An 'aha' moment: clear, direct, a little defiant, never blaming.
global_identity.graphic_language: Huge uppercase headline with one highlighted word, three continuous-line profile silhouettes with labels, a big offer text block, a fuchsia pill and a bordered badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look).

creative_objective: Reframe the frustration of the woman who trains at home: it is not that her squats don't work, they just are not the whole plan. The first silhouette shows her pain (flat seat, jeans sagging at the back, beside her yoga mat); the next two show the 3-month plan; the offer block closes with the complete treatment and cash on delivery.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the 3-line headline with 'NO' highlighted, 2) the three silhouettes, 3) 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO X3' and the three bottles, 4) the 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' pill and the badge, 5) the small disclaimer.
art_direction.composition_style: Everything centered on a light background: headline across the top, the three silhouettes in a row in the middle with their labels below, the offer text on the left and three bottles on the right at the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Three silhouettes equal in size and evenly spaced; labels aligned on one line; offer block with clear gaps; 5% margins.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat illustration with no shadows; the bottles with soft studio light from the upper left and a contact shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 28%: 3-line headline centered, lines 1–2 in color with one word on a highlight block, line 3 in black. Middle 34%: three continuous-line profile silhouettes of the same woman side by side, each with a label below (month 1, 2, 3). Bottom 38%: left, an offer kicker, the big offer and a sub-line, then the 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' pill and the registration badge; right, three identical bottles, front one centered; tiny disclaimer at the very bottom.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: the pain (silhouette 1) and the plan over time
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: same woman in profile in jeans; silhouette 1 with sagging jeans, a rolled yoga mat and a frustrated face

three identical real closed bottles, front one centered and overlapping

forbidden_additions: Prices, strikethrough prices, 'esta semana solamente' or any false urgency
Anatomical organs or medical drawings inside the silhouettes
Loose capsules or an open bottle

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 clean ad on a flat rosy cream #FFF4F1 background, no texture. TOP ZONE (3–28% height): 3-line headline centered, Montserrat Black uppercase, very heavy and tight, each line about 7% of the canvas height: line 1 in hot fuchsia #E6177F; line 2 in hot fuchsia except the word 'NO', which is black #0E0E10 on a soft yellow #FFE08A rectangular highlight block; line 3 in black #0E0E10. MIDDLE ZONE (30–64% height): three continuous single-line profile silhouettes of THE SAME young adult woman (about 27, ponytail, sports top and jeans), facing right, drawn with a 5 px rounded stroke and a very light tint fill, evenly spaced at 20%, 50% and 80% width, each about 30% of the canvas height, from head to mid-calf. Silhouette 1 in deep magenta #B0105E: her seat line is flat and straight, the jeans sag at the back with a drooping fold of extra fabric under the back pocket, shoulders slumped, head tilted down, eyebrows pinched and mouth turned down, one hand on her lower back; a rolled yoga mat drawn in the same line stands upright beside her feet. Silhouette 2 in hot fuchsia #E6177F: same woman, posture straighter, seat line slightly rounder, jeans fitting a little better, neutral calm face. Silhouette 3 in dark plum #2B1226 with a bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 tint fill: same woman, upright and confident, seat line softly rounded and lifted, jeans fitting smoothly at the back, small smile. The difference between 1 and 3 must be clear but believable. Under each silhouette (61–64% height), a label in black Poppins SemiBold, about 3.5% of the canvas height. BOTTOM ZONE (66–99% height). LEFT (5–58% width): an offer kicker in black Montserrat ExtraBold condensed uppercase (about 4% high); under it the big offer in 2 lines, Montserrat Black condensed uppercase, 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' in black and 'X3' huge in hot fuchsia #E6177F; under it a sub-line in Poppins SemiBold dark plum; then (90–97% height) a rounded hot fuchsia #E6177F pill with white Montserrat Black uppercase text and a small white hand-and-coin icon, and right beside it a rounded badge with a dark plum #2B1226 fill, a solid 3 px hot-fuchsia border and a small white shield icon, the registration text in white Poppins Bold uppercase on two lines. RIGHT (60–96% width, 64–96% height): three identical real product bottles, front view, the center one in front and about 30% of the canvas height, the two behind slightly smaller and partially hidden, all labels facing the camera, the front label fully readable, soft studio light from the upper left, a soft contact shadow, two small green aguaje palm leaf tips at their base, not touching the right edge. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottles; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret them. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Always closed with caps on; no loose capsules; labels read the right way round, never mirrored. At the very bottom center (97–99% height), a tiny disclaimer in grey #7A6A72 Poppins Regular. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents, nothing else written anywhere.

mandatory_visual_elements: Three continuous-line profile silhouettes of the same woman in jeans (the row covers at least 25% of the canvas): 1 frustrated with jeans sagging at the back and a rolled yoga mat, 2 calmer, 3 confident with a softly rounded seat
Yellow highlight block behind the word 'NO'
Three identical real closed bottles at the bottom right, front label readable
Hot-fuchsia 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' pill and bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: No capsules or pills anywhere; no open bottle; no other brand
No prices, strikethrough prices, percentages, 'esta semana solamente', ratings or testimonials
No logos other than the real bottle label
No organs, veins or medical drawings inside the silhouettes; no nudity
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add prices, extra badges, benefit lists, ratings, testimonials, discount labels or extra claims beyond the listed pill, badge and texts.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. The reframe does not blame or diagnose; it adds support to exercise; the monthly silhouettes follow the 3-month plan and carry 'Los resultados pueden variar'; no price, no false urgency, no medical claims.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
